name: show_gloss
description: Show English on the learner's screen. Use kind gloss after the learner presses the English help button (their message starts with English help), and kind rule for a one or two sentence explicit rule in accuracy mode. The English appears on screen only; never say it aloud.

english.description: The English gloss or rule to show. Short: one or two sentences at most.

for_text.description: The target-language word, phrase or sentence the English is about.

kind.description: gloss for a learner-requested translation, rule for a tutor-initiated explicit rule. Defaults to gloss.
